reviews.x: I loved this brush so much I ordered another one.  I use this brush to apply powder all over my face and blend.  It is so soft but dense.  I have absolutely nothing bad to say about this brush.  It heard it was an IT cosmetics dupe, but I do not own the IT cosmetics brush.  Probably one of my favorite brushes!  PLUS:  It arrived sooner than expected!
I use this brush for applying Hd powders it works very well. It is very big and I love a big brush. Very good for the price.

This is SO AWESOME!!! There is a major high end brand that has this exact brush ..called luxe brush and it costs $58.00! This price and the quality is unbelievable!! This company has great products at great prices and delivery is pretty fast. Highly recommend!

Total dupe for the It Cosmetics Live Beauty Fully All Over Powder Brush #211, which is $40 at Ulta! The only difference is this one is a bit lighter in weight, but it still functions the same. Honestly, I prefer this one for bronzing because it is so lightweight. 100% recommend!

Nice large powder brush, reminds me of morphes gunmetal brushes. Slight shedding at first, but nothing major. Worth the money.

reviews.t: nice and soft better than my Sigma
reviews.x: very soft, so far I have used it everyday for about a week. I navigate to it for applying finishing powder or to brush it away. hopefully it will last long and be my favorite brush.

reviews.t: The brush itself is great but the handle could be sturdier
reviews.x: So i’ve boughten two of these and I must say that I do like the brushes. The bristles are soft, they are a good size and wash nice. One downside however is about a year and a half in the handle has started coming loose. While i’m still able to use it the process of having to tighten it can definitely get annoying. The price however is inexpensive so I would probably purchase again in the future as back ups for some of my more expensive brushes.

reviews.t: I received this today and have not had a chance ...
reviews.x: I received this today and have not had a chance to use it but it feels very soft with only a loss of about 5 or 6 hairs when I washed it.  There isn't any odor to bristles and the only reason I gave it 4 stars is because the handle was a little loose when I took it out of the package but I was able to push it back and it stayed in place afterward.  Can't wait to use it.

reviews.t: Works very well as a man's shaving brush - I could find none better despite the low price
reviews.x: Excellent item, delivered promptly (to California). Well made, with good weight & balance. For me it's a shaving brush. A gel gets applied directly onto the bristles, then the brush works up a lather on my face. The bristles remain soft after repeated warm-water washings. Best surprise: zero shedding!

reviews.t: this brush is amazing. It's big and perfect for powder or even ...
reviews.x: For the price, this brush is amazing. It's big and perfect for powder or even foundation application. It's not as soft as the real IT cosmetics brush though, the quality of those bristles is unsurpassed.  However for the price, this beats every other brush on the market.

This is an amazing dupe for the bran known for amazing brushes. I am not sure if it is as soft as the original, but it is the softest brush I own. I'm very picky about brushes and do not like most knock offs, but this is 100% worth it.

reviews.t: Ships from China. Worth the wait, excellent.
reviews.x: FANTASTIC.  Don't buy the $40 one at Ulta, this one is the same one for less money.  It comes in about 2 1/2 weeks.  In fact, I will never pay full price for a makeup brush again!

I used this brush as a car detailing brush great perfect size doesn't cause scratches
Amazing the brush is worth it all the way very soft and perfect.

This brush is wonderful.  It is certainly worth the wait.  The fibers are dense but they are so soft.  I use this as an all over powder brush after applying foundation.  It gives the foundation a more finished look.  Another reviewer said this is a version of a more pricey brush.  I don't know about that but this one is great.  For the price you can't beat it.  In my view it is a must have.

reviews.t: The brushes are perfect! Much better than the picture shows
reviews.x: Received my brushes today much earlier than orginally anticipated!  This is a major bonus for shipping.  The brushes are perfect!  Much better than the picture shows.  Density is better than I thought which will make this my go to brush for everything!  Thank You for the fast shipping and quality that I just was not expecting!  I will be ordering again.  Plus all the way around!

reviews.t: The brush feels really soft. It is dense, ...
reviews.x: The brush feels really soft.  It is dense, but I wish it was just a littttleee more dense. Then I wish the handle itself had some actual weight to it.  Right now it does feel cheap, but that is why the pricing for it is so cheap.  Overall, it does what its supposed to. I use it with loose powder and my setting powders right now.

This brush is the bomb! The price was right and I wasn't sure how the quality of this brush would be but it's fantastic. My only gripe is the handle feels a little loose when you "shake" the brush. It washes beautifully with Dr. Bronner's castile soap. I hang upside down to dry. This brush is a hidden Amazon gem.

reviews.t: This brush has a nice weight to it so it doesn't feel cheap at ...
reviews.x: This brush has a nice weight to it so it doesn't feel cheap at all. It is also very smooth, very dense and not scratchy. The shape of it is not round though, its a little tapered so you can use it for a soft contour, not just face powder.  I definitely recommend this brush! You won't be disappointed.

Love this brush! I use it daily. It is soft and holds a perfect amount of product. I bought it to replace a brush I had had for years and years and was skeptical that it would hold up to my standards. Especially for the price. But it has! I highly recommend!

reviews.t: Great deal! Good Product! Fast Shipping!
reviews.x: Great deal! Good Product! Fast Shipping! This brush is SO SO SO soft. I will be buying more. It puts on makeup like a much more expensive brush. I bought it to replace my brush from The Body Shop, and you know how much those cost! I love it!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the brush as very soft and fluffy, often praising how it feels on the skin.
Many reviewers call it a great dupe for a high-end/IT Cosmetics brush at a much lower price, and consider it excellent value.
It is commonly used and praised for applying and setting powder, with its large size seen as a plus.
A recurring complaint is that the handle can be loose or come loose over time.
Some reviewers note minor shedding or hair loss when first washing the brush.
